passiveSkills.name: Admin Privileges
passiveSkills.desc:
Gain a random buff every time you raise your
Awakening Level by a certain amount.
・ ATK UP
・ Critical Rate UP
・ Max HP UP
・ Damage Reduction
・ Experience Gained UP
・ Cooldown Speed UP
In modes without Awakening Level, 3 of these effects
will be granted at random.

advancedSkills.name: Ruler's Judgment
advancedSkills.desc: Call down black lightning in front of you. Deals Dark damage and has a chance to stun.

advancedSkills.name: Noble Cremation
advancedSkills.desc: Launches a massive fireball which explodes on impact. Deals Fire damage.

advancedSkills.name: Cruel Dance
advancedSkills.desc: An exquisite dance that unleashes a flurry of sword attacks.

advancedSkills.name: Summon Sword Golem
advancedSkills.desc: Summon a Sword Golem and make it attack. It will perform a combo before disappearing.

advancedSkills.name: Heavy Attack
advancedSkills.desc: Stronger than a Normal Attack. Use after a Normal Attack combo to branch into a Combo Finish. Hold the button for Vorpal Strike, a high-speed thrust attack.
